headline: Approved a home in the floodplain at 60 Martin Street, with conditions on trees and driveway.
summary: Approvals include a negative three determination for an addition at 68 Ursula Street, tree work at 205 Billerica Street, and a certificate of compliance at 31 Lauren Way. Four items, including projects on Tanner Street and Old Ferry Road, were continued to November 18.
decisions: Continued the Request for Determination of Applicability for 10 Old Ferry Road to the November 18 meeting.
Continued the determination request for CSX Transportation's Lowell train track right-of-way to November 18.
Continued the enforcement order for 4 Epirus Drive to November 18.
Continued the Notice of Intent for 35 Tanner Street to November 18.
Approved a negative three determination for tree work at 205 Billerica Street.
Approved a standard City of Lowell Order of Conditions for the home at 60 Martin Street, with a porous driveway and replacement trees.
Approved a negative three determination for an addition at 68 Ursula Street.
Approved a Certificate of Compliance for 31 Lauren Way.
discussion: 60 Martin Street floodplain: Members discussed the house on stilts, the fill calculations, and whether the design would keep flood storage volume, and they called the stilts a safer choice.
60 Martin Street trees: Two trees in poor health at the rear of the lot were proposed for removal, and members asked that they be replaced with native shade trees through city staff.
Porous driveway pavement: Porous pavement was weighed against asphalt in the floodplain, since it can break down faster in frost and ice. The applicant agreed to porous surfaces as a condition.
205 Billerica Street trees: The owner offered to plant two replacement trees after a dead tree and a leaning tree are taken down.
68 Ursula Street silt sock: Members said a silt sock will be required to catch runoff during the slab excavation.
